unit_of_measurement.primary_measurement: NDVI and EVI as dimensionless indices, stored with a scale factor of 0.0001
unit_of_measurement.runtime_hint: Multiply `NDVI` or `EVI` by 0.0001 to obtain physical index values. Screen pixels with `SummaryQA` for routine filtering, or `DetailedQA` when specific quality bits matter. `sur_refl_b01` through `sur_refl_b07` carry the contributing surface reflectances at the same scale, and `ViewZenith`, `SolarZenith` and `RelativeAzimuth` are in degrees with a 0.01 scale. Monthly compositing means a single image already averages within its month, so avoid double-averaging when building seasonal means. Note this collection has no per-pixel `DayOfYear` band, so the exact observation date within a month is not recoverable.
